verdict.rationale: Gazebo has its own model registry, Gazebo Fuel. It offers access to ready-made robot models such as PR2, TurtleBot and iRobot Create, a C++ client library and command-line tools for Fuel servers, and copy-paste SDF snippets from model pages. That covers reusable hardware models well, but the evidence never shows a registry of reusable behaviors or plugins; custom plugins are only described as something developers build themselves. Missing for 10: a documented registry or ecosystem for reusable behavior or plugin modules, details on how Fuel pulls and versions packages, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull reusable packages or modules from a registry or ecosystem for common hardware and behaviors

citations.quote: Access numerous robots including PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create, and TurtleBot, and construct environments using other physically accurate models available through Gazebo Fuel.
A C++ client library and command line tools for interacting with Gazebo Fuel servers
click on the <> icon in the model description page... to copy an SDF snippet into your clipboard. This snippet can be pasted directly into your custom SDF file.
